1) Separate canary row for outpatient FHIR cohort: noted. Maya — can you add a dedicated gating checklist (performance SLAs, 95th-ms latency target, sample FHIR payloads)?

2) Rollback play: yes — we have a 3-stage rollback plan for inference-quality and perf regressions:
